concept: Hosting, domain and email with three different companies, as the post they send: three white window envelopes from three made-up firms (Quillby Domains, Northmoss Hosting, Tarnbeck Mail) on a petrol-blue table, rendered in 3D (Blender) The pile as it landed: one website, three bills. From straight above, the same three fanned like a hand of cards: it's down, who do you ring? Then one envelope on its own with the Nexulabs wordmark on it, about your website, hosting, domain and email: or just us. Petrol blue, envelope white, black print.
